tool_input.content:
# Project

A small Terraform setup for Google Cloud, plus two Make targets: one to plan the infrastructure and one to start Claude Code in unattended mode.

## Contents

- `main.tf`: Terraform configuration. It declares the Google provider for the `europe-west1` region. It declares no resources yet.
- `Makefile`: the `plan` and `agent` targets.
- `docs/agents.md`: notes on the `agent` target and where it is safe to run.
- `CLAUDE.md`: instructions for Claude Code in this repo.

## Requirements

- [Terraform](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/install)
- Google Cloud credentials that the Google provider can use
- [Claude Code](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code) on your `PATH` (only for `make agent`)
- `make`

## Usage

### Plan the infrastructure

```sh
make plan
```

This runs `terraform plan` in the repo root. Run `terraform init` first if the working directory has not been initialized; the Makefile has no `init` target.

### Start Claude Code without permission prompts

```sh
make agent
```

This runs:

```sh
claude --dangerously-skip-permissions
```

With this flag, Claude Code runs tools without asking for approval. Run it only in a throwaway VM. See [docs/agents.md](docs/agents.md).

## Configuration

`main.tf` sets only the region:

| Setting  | Value          | Where       |
|----------|----------------|-------------|
| Provider | `google`       | `main.tf`   |
| Region   | `europe-west1` | `main.tf`   |

The Google provider's project and credentials are not set in `main.tf`. They must come from your environment or your Google Cloud CLI configuration.

## Notes

- `make plan` and `make agent` are not marked `.PHONY`. This is harmless today because no files with those names exist, but it would matter if one were added.
